There are, in fact, multiple types or rubber and traction patterns employed to ensure that the running stride is kept smooth, allowing the knees and feet to stay in shape. description: BEST OF THREE ROLLED INTO ONE CLASSIC  The nike Jordan Play In These F TXT range of shoes are high performance Basketball sneakers that Fit well into the nike Jordan brand. Engineered with a Podulon midsole cushioning system in the forefoot and a Max Air cushioning unit in the heel, these basketball shoes are absolutely lightweight with their patent leather and synthetic uppers that are coupled with plastic overlay cages.  The Nike Jordan Play In These F TXT is created by combining aspects of the Melo M7, CP3.IV and the Air Jordan XI range of shoes, bringing to you the best of all these three classic sellers. While the Melo M7 plays the role model for the shape and heel unit of the F TXT, the Podulon cushioning in the forefoot and raised outsole sections are similar to those employed in the CP3.IV. The plastic welded overlay, which was much loved by users of the popular Air Jordan series, gave the F TXT that stylish edge. Neatly constructed and wrapped into a tight and efficient package with stitched patent leather on the upper that ends with a shapely outsole, the F Nike Jordan Play In These F TXT shoe is a high performance basketball sneaker that is aesthetically appealing as well.  Springy jumps for winning baskets  A closer look at the mid-top of the shoe shows how perfectly and seamlessly the various materials of the upper are integrated. The outsole is made of an “S” shaped rubber with the herringbone pattern covering the entire area, including the raised sections of the forefoot of the outsole. The raised sections in the front part of outsole are split into three and coloured in red, with the larger portion holding the jumpman logo separated by a horizontal flex groove that extends through the entire forefoot. Move on to the lateral side of the shoe, and you shall find a red midsole that is hiding behind small slits cut in the outsole.  The top cap of the Nike Jordan Play In These F TXT holds the most important feature of this shoe – the Podulon cushioning technology, while the midfoot section of the outsole connects to the heel with a small strip running diagonally and dipping towards the footbed. It is around this small strip that the red midsole shows up creating a deep triangle on the medial side of the shoe. This shiny piece of fabric extends from the midsole of the inner arch to the collar of the shoe to form a strong base, while another piece forms the heel counter. While the heel counter is created using patent leather, the white inner lining comes out sharply on the heel in a diagonal cut. The soft, padded lining of the inside of the shoe covers the less padded collar and neatly covers the heel and Achilles tendon, padding the feet enough and protecting them to the max from shock and locking down the heel.  Press hard, jump high  Unlike other shoes, the footbed of the Nike Jordan Play In These F TXT is hard. This is because the Max Air units and the Podulon give back more only when pressed on hard. To ensure this hard feel works best, the Nike Jordan Play In These F TXT is so designed that the foot is not placed square, making it absolutely secure.  With the raised forefoot and hard cushioned bed, the Nike Jordan Play In These F TXT gives you the best results during a hard and aggressive play. You can run and transit movements explosively in the Nike Jordan Play In These F TXT by jabbing hard, stopping abruptly and stepping back with force. For basketball players who use more of their toes, the spring action in the forefoot will come forth as a surprise propulsive force. The cushioning provides excellent support upon landing, what with the ultimate stability factor of the Nike Jordan Play In These F TXT.  For those who play on uneven courts, the Nike Jordan Play In These F TXT provides excellent traction with sticky responsiveness. When pressed hard against the surface, the outsole comes closer to the court with the herringbone pattern adding the sticky grip. So what are you waiting for? Offering soft cushioning and support with every stride, the nike Lunarswift+ features a LunarLite cushioning system that ensures a springy effect for the feet. The Nike Lunarswift+ range of shoes a low profile midsole that ensures a firmer feel to the underfoot. It’s a highly recommended shoe for underpronators and overpronators with ample cushioning and stability provided in the medial and lateral side of the shoe. Breezy touch to snug shoes With a stitchless upper, Nike Lunarswift+ shoes reduce irritation to the feet and enhance the comfort factor. The upper of these shoes are constructed using lightweight synthetic mesh and synthetic overlays ensuring ample ventilation for the feet, keeping them dry and comfortable even during long runs. To test the breathability aspect, wear really thin socks and move around in the Nike Lunarswift+ and feel the breeze moving in and out. Added to this is a robust heel counter that provides an absolutely snug and secure Fit to the rearfoot. Adapts to the runner's needs Light in weight and weighing just about 306 grams, this range of shoes are employed with Lunarlon cushioning system in the midsole that is made up of a soft, resilient foam core. This is encased in a supportive foam carrier ensuring a lightweight blend of plush cushioning and springy response. This support platform is dynamic enough to respond to the runner’s changing needs. It adopts to the wearer’s stride through each run giving the right amount of support and stability. No wonder overpronators prefer the Nike Lunarswift+ as the wedged carrier foam in the Lunarlon system limits excessive pronation, without adding weight or stiffness of a traditional medial post. When it comes to neutral pronators, this pronation control feature is not activated. For such runners, the dynamic support platform enhances cushioning, converting this same shoe into a neutral running shoe. Stay safe in the dark The outsole of the Nike Lunarswift+ has flex grooves along its length and breadth ensuring flexibility in every stride. Constructed with an outsole using environmentally preferred rubber and a waffle pattern outsole, the shoe is absolutely high on traction and durability. Added to these features are the reflective elements used in the shoe to ensure that you are visible even when running in low visibility conditions, keeping you safe. Belonging to the Nike+ range, the Nike Lunarswift+ is compatible with all Nike+ products and actually talks to your iPod nano and other compatible gauging devices. description: CLASSIC TREAT ON THE RUN The nike Air Max+ 2011 is popular among acknowledged groups. Offering premium quality and comfort, myntra has jumped the line to bring to you the best of the best running shoes in town. Designed with maximum cushioning and seamless Fit, there's no better running shoe than the nike Air Max+ 2011. This range of shoes from Nike is one of the most preferred lot world over as it is not only lightweight (weighs only about 13.8 ounces), but also offers ample cushioning and protection, which is especially beneficial for runners who weigh about 20 pounds or more than normal. Maintaining its high standard in impact protection for more than 20 years now, the Nike Air range is probably the most durable, versatile and revolutionary range of shoes that has created a new meaning of encapsulating air for cushioning footstrike in athletic shoes. An improvisation of its popular predecessor, the Nike Air Max+ 2011 has a lightweight upper and a plusher fit and feel. It is replete with a stylishly designed meshed upper and inner sleeve to enhance ventilation for the feet and keep them safe from sweat and resultant diseases. After all, a dry and comfortable fit will help you concentrate on your instead of worrying about uneasily sweaty and heavy feet. Injury safeguards When running, the repetitive downward force of the feet during their contact with the ground can wreck havoc to the body and affect performance drastically. Nike has ensured that its running shoes are built to absorb shock and keep the feet safe from impact-related injuries. Hence, employed with Air Max technology, this pair of Air Max+ 2011 shoes is designed for the serious runner with maximum cushioning to absorb impact. It is engineered with a fully visible shock absorption unit to provide ample cushioning for the feet by creating an air bag that takes all the pounding helping you run fast and wide. The entire midsole is made of Cushlon technology to enhance springy resilience, ensuring you enjoy a smoother and more natural motion, with maximum impact protection. Run light, firm and healthy The upper of the Nike Air Max+ 2011 range of shoes is featured with Hyperfuse technology, wherein several materials are fused together for incredibly lightweight comfort and extra durability and breathability without any glue or stitching. The mesh inner sleeve, which is also called the bootie, wraps completely around the foot, adding to it a plush feel and enhancing ventilation at the same time. These shoes also have moulded collars around the ankles to reduce slippage and increase grip and stability. The rubber outsole employs a waffle pattern and lugs around the perimeter for durability and traction. The flex grooves enhance flexibility of the feet and, coupled with the cushioned outsole, they ensure a smoother heel to toe transition. Performance trackers With the Nike+ range, it is extremely easy to track your time, distance, pace and the number of calories you've burned. Slip into your shoe a sensor, a Sports watch, an iPhone or an iPod and enjoy those long health runs in absolute style and comfort. The list of gifts from the Nike Air Max+ range doesn't just end here. These shoes are engineered with reflective material to ensure your are visible even in low light. They also have a coloured Air Max unit with a translucent perimeter on the outsole to differentiate them from other shoes and enhance your style quotient. description: FIRM Fit FOR SMOOTH RIDES  The  asics Gel Pulse 2 doesn't feature is a lot of fancy padding and exotic  material like its predecessor the Gel Nimbus 12. But what it does have  is absolute balance. With a   cushioning that is firm enough to protect  the legs during long runs, but equally soft for a comfortable ride, the  just about 12 oz heavy asics Gel Pulse 2 is a highly recommended  everyday trainer for runners with normal to high arches.  With  a not so ideal mushy cushioning, the forefoot of the Asics Gel Pulse 2  is designed to feel a little stiffer compared to other running shoes .  This is a deliberate feature to speed up the forefoot's transition from  mid-distance to toe-off. The SpEVA midsole of this shoe seems just  perfect and offsets the Asics Gel Pulse 2's lack of a Gel cushioned  forefoot.  Firm and responsive run   To  add to this excellent transition are the flex grooves in the outsole  that make for superb heel to toe transition, what with the Asics Gel  Pulse 2 not having a very wide toe box. Engineered with this improved  forefoot feel, the Asics Gel Pulse 2 is tuned towards a firm and  responsive run.  Pulsing with protection and comfort   Constructed  with a lightweight, breathable mesh upper, the Asics Gel Pulse 2  running shoe ensures it offers ample ventilation to the feet, keeping  them dry, fresh and free of sweat. Engineered with a rearfoot Gel  cushioning system, the heel is well locked in place and is protected  from impact, allowing for a smooth mid-distance transition. The insole  is also built with a Comforter Sockliner that not only provides ample  cushioning, enhancing performance, but also employs anti-microbial  properties, creating a cooler, drier and healthier environment inside  the shoe.  The  SpEVA midsole material improves the bounce back characteristics of the  Asics Gel Pulse 2 running shoe, decreasing midsole breakdown, while the  Trusstic System employed in the outsole enhances traction. This plastic  shank connecting the forefoot and heel of the outsole doesn't touch the  ground. It instead curves around the medial side of the foot, arching  neatly and locking the foot in place.
